title: A SELECT over an ESDS: ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL, the data set a NONINDEXED cluster
shapes: AIXA AIXAESD: SELECT LOG-FILE ASSIGN TO LOGESD ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL; AIXADEF defines PROD.AIXA.LOG NONINDEXED
asserts: The SELECT is one file_control fact (select LOG-FILE, assign LOGESD, organization SEQUENTIAL, access_mode SEQUENTIAL, record_key null) with no alternate_keys and no relative_key. The COBOL source alone does not say the file is an ESDS rather than a QSAM data set: only the DEFINE CLUSTER NONINDEXED card for PROD.AIXA.LOG (H-0082) does.

citations.doc: Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.4 Language Reference (SC27-8713-03)
citations.quote: A predecessor-successor relationship among the records in the file is established by the order in which records are placed in the file when it is created or extended.
